description: This file contains test scripts for the Project schema, including subtests for inventory, articles cached units, deletion, and staleness checks, utilizing Test2, DateTime, and a custom TestDB module.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the inventory counts for a project with ID 1.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the caching of article units, including cache invalidation and memory cycle detection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Test subroutine that deletes all projects and verifies that certain tables are emptied.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the staleness status of projects based on date.
